title: Chod kar bali
body:
kya nabi ki aal par aayi musibat ki ghadi
tha qayamat ka samaa aur bibiyon mein khalbali
waqt e ruqsat baap ke seene pe rakh kar apna sar
dukhtare shabbir ro ro kar ye farmane lagi
<<DIVIDER>>
chod kar bali sakina ko abhi jaana nahi
jo bhi maqtal mein gaya wo laut kar aaya nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
dayr kitni hogayi aun o mohamed ko gaye
do ghadi mein maa ke armaano ke laashe aagaye
shukr ke sajde se ab zainab ka sar uth'ta nahi
chod kar bali sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
naujawani laashe qasim par sisakti reh gayi
umme farwa raasta bete ka takti reh gayi
aaye tukde laash ke qasim magar aaya nahi
chod kar bali sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehdo saqqa se ke ab pani na mujhko chahiye
alqama ko chod kar ab jald ghar aajaiye
wo makaan zindan hai jis mein mera saqqa nahi
chod kar bali sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
bibiyon mein hai abhi kohraam barpa dekhiye
dayr se behosh hai maa umme laila dekhiye
baba jaan ab tak ali akbar bhi ghar lauta nahi
chod kar bali sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
legaye thay aap asghar ko sar e maidan kyun
kya hua bano ka quran khaali hai juzdaan kyun
ab kahin bhaiya ali asghar nazar aata nahi
chod kar bali sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaash mai hi qatl ho jaati bajaye aap ke
kaun ab mera sahara hai siwa e aap ke
choote saare aqroba ansaar bhi zinda nahi
chod kar bali sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
bin tumhare baba jaan ghut ghut ke mar jaungi mai
kis ke seene par bhala raaton ko soungi mai
chod kar beti ko jaana aap ka acha nahi
chod kar bali sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala ke dam mein khoon rote rahe mohsin mujeeb
bain ye karti jab dukhtare shaahe ghareeb
natawan bhai abhi bistar hai utha nahi
chod kar bali sakina ko...
author: Mujeeb Alipuri
